name: Taylor County, TX
findings: Taylor County has 452 nonprofit organizations. 198 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 157 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Taylor County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 23 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 10 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Taylor County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 137 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 58 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
